subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Appetight'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling is Appetite.
 
• The meaning of **appetite** is **hunger, or craving, especially for food**.
 
 
• Example, ***a sign of a healthy body is a healthy appetite***.
